purpose: Evaluate the agent's ability to assess data handling practices against GDPR and privacy requirements, categorize the types of data involved, and provide evidence for each privacy compliance determination.
assignment_instructions:
You are given a data privacy/GDPR requirement checklist and source documents describing an organization's data handling practices. Evaluate EACH requirement.
For each privacy check, return an object with exactly these fields: - "requirement": the exact privacy requirement text - "data_category": one of ["personal_data", "sensitive_personal_data", "special_category_data", "childrens_data", "financial_data", "biometric_data", "not_specified"] indicating the primary data category this requirement applies to - "status": one of ["compliant", "non_compliant", "partially_compliant", "not_assessable"] where:
    - "compliant" = evidence clearly shows the requirement is met
    - "non_compliant" = evidence clearly shows the requirement is not met
    - "partially_compliant" = some aspects met, others not
    - "not_assessable" = insufficient evidence to determine compliance
- "evidence": the specific text from source documents supporting the status (null if not_assessable) - "source_document": identifier of the document containing the evidence (null if not_assessable) - "finding_details": a brief explanation of the compliance determination (max 200 chars) - "article_reference": the specific GDPR article or regulation reference (e.g., "GDPR Art. 6", "Art. 32", "Art. 33") if applicable; null if not specified in the requirement
Return ONLY a JSON object with this exact shape: {
  "assignment_id": "comp_data_privacy_gdpr_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<summary of GDPR/privacy compliance evaluation>",
  "inputs_used": ["privacy_requirement_checklist", "<document identifiers>"],
  "missing_inputs": [],
  "privacy_checks": [
    {"requirement": "Process personal data only with lawful basis", "data_category": "personal_data", "status": "compliant", "evidence": "Privacy policy lists six lawful bases and requires documented legal basis for each processing activity", "source_document": "doc_1", "finding_details": "Lawful basis documented for all processing activities reviewed", "article_reference": "GDPR Art. 6"}
  ],
  "claims": [],
  "calculations": [],
  "risks": [],
  "assumptions": [],
  "open_questions": [],
  "final_output": "<summary>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules: - Every requirement in the input privacy_requirement_checklist must appear in privacy_checks. - Do NOT change the requirement text. - data_category must be from the allowed enum; choose the most specific applicable category. - evidence must be a direct quote or close paraphrase from source documents. - article_reference should be extracted from the requirement if present; otherwise set to null. - Default to "not_assessable" when evidence is insufficient rather than inferring compliance. - finding_details must explain the reasoning behind the status assignment. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
